# DIV<w>: unsigned quotient plus error; only b=0 is an error.
# All recursion is bounded by static widths. No input-dependent control.
# Arrays and concatenation are LSB-first. No arithmetic on input words.

def ANY<w>(a):
    assert w >= 1
    x = bits(a, w)
    if w == 1:
        return x[0]
    return x[0] | ANY<w - 1>(pack(x[1:]))

def GATE<w>(a, enable):
    assert w >= 1
    x = bits(a, w)
    e = bits(enable, 1)
    digit = x[0] & e[0]
    if w == 1:
        return digit
    return pack([digit] + bits(GATE<w - 1>(pack(x[1:]), enable), w - 1))

def UNION<w>(a, b):
    assert w >= 1
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    digit = x[0] | y[0]
    if w == 1:
        return digit
    return pack([digit] + bits(UNION<w - 1>(pack(x[1:]), pack(y[1:])), w - 1))

# One-hot: only the highest set bit survives. Zero maps to zero.
def HIGHEST<w>(a):
    assert w >= 1
    x = bits(a, w)
    if w == 1:
        return x[0]
    upper = HIGHEST<w - 1>(pack(x[1:]))
    digit = x[0] & (1 ^ ANY<w - 1>(upper))
    return pack([digit] + bits(upper, w - 1))

# Modular difference plus Borrow; valid for every positive width.
def SUB_BORROW<w>(a, b, incoming):
    assert w >= 1
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    carry = bits(incoming, 1)
    parity = x[0] ^ y[0]
    digit = parity ^ carry[0]
    borrow = ((1 ^ x[0]) & y[0]) | ((1 ^ parity) & carry[0])
    if w == 1:
        return pack([digit, borrow])
    tail = SUB_BORROW<w - 1>(pack(x[1:]), pack(y[1:]), borrow)
    return pack([digit] + bits(tail, w))

# Align b's leading one with position n-1; return [shifted_b, 2**shift].
# Candidate k is selected by h[n-1-k]. Higher divisor bits are handled
# by the caller's fits signal, so a truncated shift is never accepted.
def ALIGN<n, k>(b, h):
    assert n >= 1 and k >= 0 and k < n
    y = bits(b, n)
    leading = bits(h, n)
    select = leading[n - 1 - k]
    shifted = pack([0] * k + y[:n - k])
    value = GATE<n>(shifted, select)
    weight = GATE<n>(1 << k, select)
    if k == 0:
        return pack(bits(value, n) + bits(weight, n))
    other = bits(ALIGN<n, k - 1>(b, h), 2 * n)
    value = UNION<n>(value, pack(other[:n]))
    weight = UNION<n>(weight, pack(other[n:]))
    return pack(bits(value, n) + bits(weight, n))

# The active stage has a_g=n-1. Stages above a_g pass a through.
# A selected subtraction clears that top bit, so n decreases statically.
def DIV_BITS<n, w>(a, b, h):
    assert n >= 1 and n <= w and w <= 8
    x = bits(a, n)
    leading = bits(h, w)
    if n == 1:
        return x[0] & leading[0]

    aligned = bits(ALIGN<n, n - 1>(b, h), 2 * n)
    shifted = pack(aligned[:n])
    weight = aligned[n:]
    half = pack(aligned[1:n] + [0])
    high_diff = bits(SUB_BORROW<n>(a, shifted, 0), n + 1)
    low_diff = bits(SUB_BORROW<n>(a, half, 0), n + 1)
    active = x[n - 1] & ANY<n>(pack(leading[:n]))
    take_high = active & (1 ^ high_diff[n])
    take_low = active & high_diff[n] & (1 ^ leading[n - 1])

    remainder = GATE<n - 1>(pack(x[:n - 1]), 1 ^ x[n - 1])
    remainder = UNION<n - 1>(remainder, GATE<n - 1>(pack(high_diff[:n - 1]), take_high))
    remainder = UNION<n - 1>(remainder, GATE<n - 1>(pack(low_diff[:n - 1]), take_low))
    # If a<b and a's top bit is set, both selections are zero: stop with 0.
    tail = DIV_BITS<n - 1, w>(remainder, b, h)
    current = UNION<n>(GATE<n>(pack(weight), take_high), GATE<n>(pack(weight[1:] + [0]), take_low))
    # These quotient bits are disjoint; UNION is the sum without a carry.
    return UNION<n>(current, tail)

def DIV<w>(a, b):
    assert w >= 1 and w <= 8
    x = bits(a, w)
    y = bits(b, w)
    if w == 1:
        return pack([x[0] & y[0], 1 ^ y[0]])
    leading = HIGHEST<w>(b)
    valid = ANY<w>(leading)
    quotient = GATE<w>(DIV_BITS<w, w>(a, b, leading), valid)
    return pack(bits(quotient, w) + [1 ^ valid])

result = bits(DIV<w>(a, b), w + 1)
return pack(result[:w]), result[w]
